It is submitted on behalf of the complainant that the complaint case is pending since 2016 still the evidences have not been recorded under Section 244 Cr.P.C. Trial is going on at a very slow pace.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner further prays that the aforesaid case may be expedited, to which learned A.G.A. has no objection.
6. Supplementary Affidavit filed by learned counsel for the petitioner containing the order-sheet of the trial court, is taken on record.

7. On due consideration to the innocuous prayer of the petitioner to expedite the complaint case, so also perusal of the record, the petition is disposed of with a direction to the trial court to expedite and conclude the same expeditiously and preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
